description_html:
Documentation

 

3D Model Application Instruction

 

Overview

The LED Lamp Kit contains all the necessary hardware components for assembling an LED Lamp. To complete the assembly for an entirely functional piece, users also need to download the model files and 3D print the remaining parts.

Creator Program: The Creator Program is a collaborative program between Bambu Lab and creators. Creators unleash their creativity to design 3D printing models, while Bambu Lab provides compatible hardware kits for those designs.

Compatible Models Creators Model Links

 Mc2.project3D Arc Reactor MK1

 TBone_427120 Moon Globe for LED Lamp 001

BellSprout Lamp LED Kit SavageLau BellSprout Lamp LED Kit
Design Lamp - The Wave SJANBERRY DESIGN Design Lamp - The Wave
Bonsai Desk Lamp 3dpaintlab Bonsai Desk Lamp

Product Specifications


 
Product Size D59*H8 mm Packaging Size 100*69*35 mm
Product Weight 58 g Gross Weight 72 g
Voltage DC 5V Power 3W
Cable Length 1.5 m Color Temperature Warm White

In the Box

Item Number Item Name Quantity
1 LED Lamp 1
2 BT3x12 FHCS Self Tapping Screw 2
3 D40mm Double-sided Tape 1

Notes

1. Please power the device using a USB power supply with the specified voltage.

2. It is recommended for indoor use at room temperature.

3. Wipe with a clean cloth and avoid splashing or immersing in water.

4. BT3x12 SHCS Self Tapping Screw is the alternative to the screws included in the kit.
